# Equinox Forge v0.46 — Recursive Macro Collapse

This frozen benchmark verifies that stable common numeric relation structures collapse into deterministic macro IDs, that macro IDs can themselves become members of a higher macro, and that higher-order collapse removes parent-owned facts from child-local macro storage without mutating the canonical base graph.

Run:

```bash
eqforge-recursive-macro --out out/v0_46_recursive_macro_collapse
```
